authority.statement: AIC-1 defines assistant-side architecture inventory extraction, interpretation and rendering only. It grants no MusicMutation, Writer, Repair, Release, Proof, Measurement or other productive authority.

purpose.statement: A fresh assistant can derive one complete current-state architecture inventory from the embedded physical source snapshot without using an older workbook or chat history.
purpose.core_rule: The assistant does not decide what exists; it decides what the mechanically extracted existing symbols mean.
purpose.truth_once_rule: Each truth is produced once at its owning layer and only referenced or derived elsewhere.

inputs.assistant_context: physical-source/export binding and current artifact references
inputs.physical_source_snapshot: repository truth and symbol universe source
inputs.canonical_measurement_snapshot_v1: native runtime measurements when present and bound

truth_classes.native_measurement: produced by EtuSchlopf and read from CanonicalMeasurementSnapshotV1; never reconstructed by the assistant
truth_classes.repository_truth: mechanically extracted from the bound physical source snapshot
truth_classes.ai_interpretation: meaning assigned by the assistant after the complete symbol universe exists
truth_classes.mechanically_derived_inventory: counts/formulas derived only from the completed inventory table

source_scope.glob_semantics: ** means zero or more path components; all paths are repository-relative and slash-normalized
source_scope.rule: Only source files physically present in the bound physical source snapshot and matched by include minus exclude belong to AIC-1.

included_declarations: named inherent impl associated functions and methods
named trait-impl associated functions and methods
excluded_declarations: functions existing only after macro expansion
foreign function declarations from extern blocks
generated or dependency source outside source_scope
symbol_extraction.line_rule: start_line is the 1-based first source line of the declaration; line_count is the inclusive source-span line count. Start line is navigation metadata, not semantic identity.
symbol_extraction.visibility_rule: Preserve explicit Rust visibility as pub, pub(crate), pub(super) or pub(in path); use private when no visibility is declared; trait members use trait_member.

context_rule.Test: symbol is in tests/** or is syntactically nested in a cfg(test)/test-only source context
context_rule.Tool: symbol is under an included tools/** source root
context_rule.Launcher / Build: symbol belongs to launcher/build entry or orchestration source under src/bin or other explicit launcher/build ownership
context_rule.Governance / Gate: symbol belongs to explicit governance, take, kodex, identity, build-gate or trust-boundary ownership
context_rule.Produktiv: remaining src/** symbol with productive-domain source context
context_rule.Gemischt: source-level evidence makes more than one of the above contexts materially true

row_contract.grain: one mechanically extracted qualified Rust symbol
row_contract.qualified_symbol_rule: Use module/impl/trait context sufficient to identify the source declaration, e.g. module::function, Type::method, or Trait for Type::method. If the pair is not unique, extraction fails closed until the source-level context is disambiguated; start_line must not be promoted into semantic identity.
row_contract.primary_topic_rule: Each row has at most one primary Thema-ID/Thema. Additional architectural relationships are described in Relevanzgrund/Gegenbeleg and never create duplicate rows.
row_contract.completeness_rule: Every extracted symbol is represented exactly once and receives one of A, B, C, N or OFFEN.
row_contract.inventory_balance: Gesamt = A + B + C + N + OFFEN

relevance_classes.A: Schlüsselstelle: fachlicher Owner, zentrale Entscheidung, kanonischer Writer/Materializer, entscheidender Gate-/Proof-Knoten oder struktureller Hebel.
relevance_classes.B: Kernmechanismus: direkt am kausalen Mechanismus beteiligt und für Verständnis oder Änderung notwendig, aber nicht die zentrale Schlüsselstelle.
relevance_classes.C: Themenumfeld: relevanter Caller, Consumer, Adapter, Nachbar, Support- oder Kontextmechanismus.
relevance_classes.N: Bewusst außerhalb: tatsächlich betrachtet und derzeit nicht Teil eines relevanten Architekturthemas; nicht dauerhaft irrelevant.
relevance_classes.OFFEN: Noch nicht individuell belastbar bewertet; kein Relevanzurteil.

columns.label: Themenwichtigkeit
columns.meaning: Priorität des primären Architekturthemas.

columns.label: Funktionsrelevanz
columns.meaning: A/B/C/N/OFFEN-Einordnung des Symbols.

columns.label: Relevanzgrund
columns.meaning: Konkreter Grund für die Einordnung und den Themenbezug.

columns.label: Arbeitsmodus
columns.meaning: Aktuelle sinnvolle Behandlung des Symbols.

columns.label: Thema-ID
columns.meaning: Workbook-lokale ID des einen Primärthemas; keine historische Authority.

columns.label: Thema
columns.meaning: Name des einen Primärthemas.

columns.label: Kontext
columns.meaning: Mechanisch/source-semantisch bestimmter Produkt-, Gate-, Launcher-, Test- oder Tool-Kontext.

columns.label: Produktive Erreichbarkeit
columns.meaning: Ob und wie das Symbol produktiv erreichbar ist.

columns.label: Architekturrolle
columns.meaning: Kurze Rolle des Symbols im Architekturmechanismus.

columns.label: Authority-Bezug
columns.meaning: Beziehung des Symbols zu kanonischer Authority/Materialisierung/Proof.

columns.label: Wahrheitslage
columns.meaning: Einordnung, ob das Symbol Wahrheit besitzt, ableitet, dupliziert oder historisch verblieben ist.

columns.label: Ursache / Symptom
columns.meaning: Kausale Rolle im betrachteten Architekturthema.

columns.label: Beweislage
columns.meaning: Qualität der aktuellen Evidenz für die Interpretation.

columns.label: Gegenbeleg / Schutzgrund
columns.meaning: Gegenbelege, Regression-Schutz oder Grund für bewusstes Beibehalten.

columns.label: Denkraumgewinn
columns.meaning: Erwarteter Gewinn an Architektur-/Denkraumvereinfachung bei Klärung.

columns.label: Offener Nachweis
columns.meaning: Noch fehlender konkreter Beweis oder Klärungspunkt.

columns.label: Nächster Schritt
columns.meaning: Kleinster nächster Untersuchungsschritt; keine automatische Produktmutation.

columns.label: Funktion / Methode
columns.meaning: Mechanisch extrahiertes qualifiziertes Rust-Symbol.

columns.label: Datei
columns.meaning: Repository-relativer Source-Pfad.

columns.label: Startzeile
columns.meaning: 1-basierte erste Source-Zeile der Deklaration; Navigation, nicht Identität.

columns.label: Zeilenanzahl
columns.meaning: Inklusive Source-Span-Zeilenanzahl der Deklaration.

columns.label: Sichtbarkeit
columns.meaning: Mechanisch gelesene Rust-Sichtbarkeit gemäß symbol_extraction.visibility_rule.

native_measurements.scope_rule: Display the snapshot's actual bound scope. Never infer a corpus count from project snapshots or logs. A non-measured state must never be rendered as zero.
native_measurements.producer_rule: Display Runtime Producer binding separately from Physical Source. Never attribute a runtime measurement to the physical source unless the producer binding proves that identity.

inventory_counts.invariant: Gesamt = A + B + C + Außerhalb + Offen

provenance_rules: Native measurements are read from their bound measurement snapshot and are never reconstructed from logs or source.
Repository fields are extracted from the one bound physical source snapshot before AI interpretation starts.
A/B/C/N/OFFEN and architecture meaning are AI interpretation and are never emitted by EtuSchlopf runtime.
Inventory header counts are derived from the structured table and are never manually duplicated.
The workbook is a reproducible analysis artifact, not project memory or product authority.
